text:
hana: quick intake — onboarding halcyon-13b (nominal 13B, opt-32k). Need perf + quant + quality checks before we add to model-catalog. target: p99 < 220ms @ batch=1 @ ctx=2048, throughput >= 120 tok/s @ batch=8. Prefer int8 path but please validate int4 fallback. memory target: fit on single A100-40G for small-prod. attaching proposed checklist below.

bench-bot: auto: created bench job halcyon-13b-intake-1881234567, assigned to dev team queue. link: https://internal.bench/1881234567

devon: +1. Proposed sweep order: 
- smoke run warmup (fp16) to sanity-check logits and zero OOMs
- ctx sweep: 512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192 (note: halcyon has opt-32k, but start small)
- batch sweep for throughput: batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16] at each ctx where feasible
- quant smoke: int8 static -> compare perplexity delta on eval set -> int4 if int8 good but memory still high
- p99 latency profile with realistic prefix caching for streaming scenarios

eli: added checklist items: 
- regression eval: run eval-suite v2 (safety, factuality, summarization, code) and produce delta vs our reference model (atlas-7b-v2)
- decode settings: greedy, top-p=0.95, temp=0.2, max_new_tokens=256 for perf comparability
- save KV cache size stats and peak_mem per step

chris: priority: this is medium-high. Customer pilot needs halcyon in Dedicated next month. Recommending dedicated slot for quant smoke. If int8 fails, fallback to fp16 with batching ops tuned. Also ensure rollout policy in console allows canary on 10% traffic.

devon: running initial smoke now. command: 
```
bench-run --model halcyon-13b --profile perf --ctx 2048 --batch 1 --decode "top_p=0.95,temp=0.2" --out /tmp/halcyon-smoke.json
```
Expect ~2-3m job. Will post results.

bench-bot: auto: job halcyon-13b-intake-1881234567-smoke queued on runner-gpu-5

devon: smoke done. quick paste of key outputs: 
```
summary: tokens=12000, avg_tok_time=0.0068s, tok/s=146.5, p50=22ms, p95=118ms, p99=205ms, peak_mem=28.4GB, OOM=false
```
Looks promising for batch=1 fp16. p99=205ms at ctx=2048 meets target.

hana: nice! next steps: run batch sweep at ctx=2048 and ctx=4096, then quant-int8 static and compare eval deltas. assign to eli for quant runs and to devon for batching sweeps.

eli: ack. plan for quant: 
- export HF weights -> run `quantize --mode int8 --calib-set eval100`
- run eval-suite v2 and compute delta metrics: rouge, exact-match, bertscore.
- if rouge drop > 3% or EM drop > 2% reject int8 for production.

devon: launching batch sweep now. Posting summarized table when finished.

bench-bot: auto: batch-sweep job 1881234588 started (ctx=2048), 5 workers

devon: quick interim numbers (ctx=2048): 
- batch=1: tok/s=147, p99=205ms
- batch=2: tok/s=260, p99=240ms
- batch=4: tok/s=420, p99=310ms
- batch=8: tok/s=720, p99=520ms (but 95th still ~300ms)
- batch=16: OOM on A100-40G

eli: noted. throughput target (>=120 tok/s @ batch=8) is satisfied (we're at 720 tok/s), but p99 at batch=8 is high; check continuous batching/KV cache warm path to reduce p99. Also try mixed-batch strategy: small latency-sensitive route (batch=1) and background batch lane (batch=8).

chris: ops note: for Dedicated we can tune autoscaler to keep some nodes in hot-warm state to reduce cold-start p99. Also consider quant-int8 on dedicated GPUs with slightly higher memory to allow batch=16 if needed.

eli: quant-int8 results are in (calib on eval100):
```
int8: rouge-l delta = -1.8%, em delta = -0.9%, bertscore delta = -0.6%, peak_mem=18.6GB, p99=215ms (batch=1)
```
QA pass thresholds OK. Will run int4 trial but expect bigger quality drop.

devon: follow-up ctx sweep (4096): batch=1 p99=360ms (fp16), batch=2 p99=420ms, throughput decreases per tok because longer kv handling. Need to profile kernel selection.

hana: good to know. Action items: 
- eli: finish int4 exploratory and upload eval diffs to /datasets/halcyon/1881234567/diffs.csv
- devon: open perf-issue ticket if p99 regression for ctx>2048 persists (include `nvprof` traces and kernel timelines)
- chris: reserve dedicated slot in prod cluster for initial canary (1 node, 2 GPUs) and set rollout 10%
- bench-bot: tag model as "int8-qualified" if final int8 delta within thresholds

bench-bot: auto: assigned ticket PERF-ML-442 to devon for kernel profiling

eli: int4 quick smoke: 
```
int4: rouge-l delta = -4.6%, em delta = -3.1% -> FAIL quality threshold.
```
We'll keep int4 for experiments only.

hana: summary: halcyon-13b int8 looks production-viable for hosted + dedicated with conservative rollout. fp16 fallback needed for ctx>2048. Next sync on Monday to finalize catalog entry and rollout policy. Thanks team :thumbsup: 

chris: noted. scheduling canary for next Tue.

devon: closing bench logs to /logs/halcyon/1881234567/ and saving checkpoint for postmortem.

hana: excellent work.
